d:
Beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh men pahunche anant sinh mahaj 5 minat ke andar hi vapas laut gae. samaroh men unhonne hone vale samdhi ranvijay sinh aur damad rishikesh kumar se mulakat ki. chhote sarkar ki is chhoti lekin khas mulakat ki charcha ho rahi hai. aakhir 5 minat men hi kyon laut gae anant sinh? dekhie ye khas tasviren.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
